label: Test occurrence identification under truthful selective disclosure (inference)
rule: Apply the absence criterion and compare exact observation fibers
meaning: Reuses the archive absence lemma and the earlier populated three-event case. Applying the proposition identification criterion to the same event across two histories separates the truth of disclosed entries from recoverability of omitted events. The control supplies no actual-history, recipient uptake, normative, source-attribution or metaphysical possibility premise.
